title: Letter template management
goal: Officers upload template versions; Legal approves or withdraws them on screen, with no developer
why: Letter wording is a legal control (CTL-14). Only a Legal-approved version can be current, and the uploader can never approve their own template.
triggers: RW-LEGAL approves with a valid-from date
ace_note: No ACE read. Templates hold merge codes; the ACE values are filled in later by notice generation (E1-052).

reads.note: every merge code must be in the catalog

stores: Write-once template body storage (body_ref); ACE audit log

path.text: DOCX, size, merge codes in catalog

rules: BR1: only Approved, with approver and time, can be current (CTL-14)
BR4: every merge code must be in the catalog
BR6: a withdrawn template holds generation; there is no fallback
example: LIT-0101 uploads demand-mtg-th-v3.docx for DEMAND-MTG / TH with CASE_NO, TOTAL_OUTSTANDING
LEG-0001 approves with valid from 2026-11-20 -> v3 becomes current
